articles.summary: Dream Finders completed its Beazer Homes acquisition on Oct. 20, 2026 at $33.50 per share in cash (about $878.4M in equity). Funding included $450M of Series B convertible preferred and $572.1M from a land-bank facility. Beazer's $350M 7.25% notes due 2029 were redeemed and its unsecured credit facility repaid.
articles.why_it_matters: A $572.1M land-bank facility helped pay for the sixth-largest builder's purchase; other coverage and DFH's 10-Q search results name Millrose as the counterparty, so the Beazer lots went to a competitor rather than to Domain.
